A little note, just for you

I know your heart is heavy right now. Someone who mattered so much has stepped out of your daily life, and it hurts in a way that's hard to explain to anyone.

It's not a small thing, and you don't have to pretend it is. Cry if you need to. Stay quiet if you need to. Miss them. All of it is allowed.

But hear this too: caring that deeply says something beautiful about you. You love with your whole heart, and that will never be a weakness. Someone like that was lucky to have you, and life will bring you people who are lucky to have you again.

You are not alone in this. I'm right here, today and every day after.

With all my love, always.

Words to hold onto


Look at this person

Things to remember

Will this pain last forever?

No. It comes in waves, and the waves get farther apart. Some days will still be hard, but each one hurts a little less than the last.

Did I lose something real?

Yes, and what was real doesn't vanish. The memories, the laughter, the way you grew because of them, all of it stays with you. Distance changes the shape of a bond. It doesn't erase it.

What if I keep missing them?

Then you miss them. That's not failing at healing. Let the feeling pass through instead of fighting it. Missing someone and moving forward can happen on the same day.

What can I do today?

Drink water. Eat something warm. Step outside for ten minutes. Call or sit with someone who loves you. Sleep early. Small things count as big things right now.

What if it feels too heavy to carry?

Then please tell me, or a friend, or someone you trust. If the sadness stays for weeks and starts taking over your days, talking to a counsellor is a brave and healthy step, not a weakness.

Put it down for a while

Write what you're carrying. No one will read it. Then let it go and watch it float away.

Come here. A big, big hug.

Press and hold the heart. Imagine my arms wrapped tight around you, and don't let go until it's done.
